title: CrossVid: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Cross-Video Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper presents CrossVid, a benchmark designed to evaluate the spatial-temporal reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models across multiple videos. Its evaluation tasks, such as plot inference, step sequencing, and object counting, are focused on technical reasoning performance and do not include components related to religion, morals, or ethics.
